name: continue-budget
title: Continue budget
description: continue_budget requests native Agent approval with a nonblank reason up to 2000 characters. No item tables; native approval parts and core receipts hold state. Consent does not modify any budget. Resume through core respond.
docs: Use a TypeScript host with tsx: true in components.json before installing. Register createContinueBudgetTool() on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Requires the host's existing agevex package. Responses must use core respond, never native approveToolCall directly. See /docs/tools/continue-budget.
